multiples.label: Multiples-Based
multiples.note: P/E, P/S, EV/EBIT etc. vs peers/history · +44.4%

valuation.methodology: AlphaSpread DCF — 7-year forecast via Net Income template, Revenue Growth 10.6% (vs 5Y hist 13.5%, Wall St 3Y 12.4%), Net Margin 11.5%→12.1% (vs 5Y 13.6%, Wall St 3Y 11.7%), Discount Rate 11.0%, Terminal Growth 0%. Multiples-Based Value from P/E, P/S, EV/Sales/EBITDA/EBIT etc. vs peers/history. Intrinsic Value = AlphaSpread selected method for Tanla. Wall St target ₹734.4 sits above both. History: 3Y avg P/E 21.17x vs 12.9x today — derated into the result.

local_crosscheck.note: Local earnings-yield cross-check: PAT ₹509 Cr on ₹6,561 Cr MCap = 7.76% yield (12.9x) vs 3.7% benchmark (27.027x) → EY-implied ₹1,037 — deeper value than AlphaSpread DCF ₹689.56; gap reflects growth + margin scepticism priced into the derate.

flags.evidence: EBITDA margin ~16-17% sliding since FY22 highs; pricing pressure in SMS despite volume growth (Q4 FY26 call)
TRAI/DLT dependence; UPI-SMS notification rule change risk flagged; domestic A2P concentration
Digital Platforms single-digit/de-grew in FY25 (-1.2% YoY Q1 FY25); enterprise comms carries the number
₹12 Cr FX loss Q4 FY26 on USD-INR; international scale-up raises currency volatility
Top enterprises/OTT + telco reliance (Google, Meta, telcos); Vi history shows carrier risk is real

bottom_line.core_idea: Not an SMS vendor — trust infrastructure (Wisely + Trubloq + ATP) on a CPaaS cash engine.
bottom_line.what_changed: Bulk SMS → AI-native platform: OTT mix + ATP bank deals + Indosat 100Mn + Gartner Visionary.
bottom_line.hidden_insight: Watch gross-profit growth vs revenue growth — Q1 FY27 25.1% vs 17.8% is the quality signal.
bottom_line.what_breaks: SMS price war + EBITDA <15% with ATP stalled → derate sticks below 12x.
bottom_line.open_question: Can OTT + ATP + international hold >10% growth with FCF ≈ PAT intact?
bottom_line.takeaway: Don't pay SaaS multiples -> own the cash compounder near the AlphaSpread buy zone ₹478.

forecast.note: Shares flat at ~13.26 Cr (FV ₹1) — net cash ~₹2,127 Cr, no dilution assumed. Bear = SMS price war + EBITDA <15% + stuck at 10x. Base = 12% sales CAGR (>10% guide) + 12% PAT margin + mild re-rate 12.9x→14x. Bull = ATP + OTT + international compounding at 18%, P/E held at 18x (still below 3Y avg 21.17x). Current 12.9x derate does the work in Base/Bull.

takeaway: Tanla Platforms doesn't sell SMS — it sells trusted digital interaction at billions-message scale, and the filings say the next chapter is AI-native Wisely + trust infrastructure (Trubloq/ATP) + international replication of the Indosat playbook — built in Hyderabad, running on 20+ telco rails, converting ~94-101% of PAT into cash.
